name: Mpox
value: Clade Ib community spread in 9 European states
summary: WHO lists clade Ib community transmission in nine European countries; no new mpox emergency declared
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep, its latest found, lists community transmission of clade Ib in Czechia, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Switzerland and the UK; Africa reported 1,153 confirmed cases in the six weeks to 16 Aug, led by Madagascar (WHO). WHO treats mpox as a graded emergency with standing recommendations to August 2027. Searches on 16 Nov found no new emergency of international concern, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Risk to the general public is low. People who may be at higher risk can check NHS and UKHSA guidance on mpox symptoms and vaccine eligibility.
rubric_hit: Clade Ib community transmission in 9 countries outside Africa (WHO) meets Watch; no PHEIC in effect

sources.title: WHO — Multi-country outbreak of mpox, external situation report 69

why: Clade I mpox is more severe and has spread beyond Central Africa.
drivers: Case growth, vaccine access, travel-linked spread.
